info.title: quarrel-rs API
info.description: OpenAI-compatible inference API, Ollama-compatible shims and operations endpoints. Generation and embeddings use quarrel-engine's deterministic ReferenceBackend fixture (not Go parity); OpenAI streaming emits chat.completion.chunk events and the Ollama shims emit newline-delimited JSON.

get.summary: Self-contained WebUI with model discovery, chat (including SSE streaming) and embeddings.

post.summary: Ollama-compatible chat, backed by the same reference backend as `/v1/chat/completions`.
post.description: `stream: true` emits Ollama's newline-delimited JSON framing (`application/x-ndjson`).

200.description: Ollama chat response, or newline-delimited JSON chunks when stream=true

post.summary: Ollama-compatible text generation, backed by the same reference backend as `/v1/*`.
post.description:
`stream: true` emits Ollama's newline-delimited JSON framing (`application/x-ndjson`), reusing
the SSE producer for pacing. This is a compatibility shim, not a Go-parity model.

200.description: Ollama generate response, or newline-delimited JSON chunks when stream=true

get.summary: Swagger UI page for the generated contract. Assets are pinned from unpkg.
Readiness probe. Reports whether GGUF models were discovered.

post.summary:
OpenAI chat completions. `stream: true` returns `text/event-stream` chunks terminated by
`data: [DONE]`; heartbeats keep idle streams alive.

200.description: Chat completion JSON, or chat.completion.chunk SSE when stream=true

post.summary:
OpenAI legacy completions. Multiple prompts produce one choice per prompt.
`stream: true` uses the same `chat.completion.chunk` SSE framing as chat completions.

200.description: Text completion, or chunked SSE when stream=true

post.summary: Deterministic pseudo-embeddings from reference-backend logits, as float arrays or base64.

get.summary: OpenAI model list, discovered from `config.models_dir` by `quarrel_core::resolver`.

ChatChoice.description: One choice in a non-streaming chat response.

message.description: Generated message; the role is always `assistant`.

tool_calls.description: Tool calls emitted with this choice, absent for ordinary text responses.

ChatCompletionChunk.description: One `chat.completion.chunk` emitted on the SSE stream.

created.description: Unix creation timestamp shared by every chunk of one stream.

id.description: Identifier shared by every chunk of one stream.

ChatCompletionRequest.description:
Subset of the OpenAI chat-completion request understood by the reference backend.

Fields not listed here are ignored on input so unmodified OpenAI SDKs can send their defaults.

messages.description: Conversation messages, rendered as a `role: content` prompt.

model.description: Model id to generate with; must appear in `GET /v1/models`.

repetition_penalty.description: Repetition penalty applied to already-generated tokens.

oneOf.description: Stop strings, either one string or a list of strings.
How the service may use the declared tools.

tools.description: Optional tool definitions; requests without tools keep the legacy response shape.

ChatDelta.description: Incremental message content in an SSE chunk.

content.description: Generated text fragment; absent on the empty role and finish chunks.

role.description: Role, present only in the first chunk of a stream.

tool_calls.description: Incremental tool-call fragments; absent on ordinary text streams.

ChatMessage.description: A chat message in OpenAI role/content form.

content.description: Message content. A JSON `null` from OpenAI SDKs is accepted as empty text.

tool_call_id.description: Identifier of the tool call this message answers, for `role: "tool"`.

tool_calls.description: Tool calls emitted by an assistant message, when present.

ChatStreamChoice.description: One choice in an SSE chunk.

finish_reason.description: Finish reason, present only on the last chunk before `[DONE]`.

CompletionChoice.description: One choice in a completion response.

model.description: Model id to generate with; must appear in `GET /v1/models`.

prompt.description: Prompt text, either one string or a list of strings.

repetition_penalty.description: Repetition penalty applied to already-generated tokens.

data.description: One embedding per input string, in request order.

model.description: Model used to produce the embeddings.

EmbeddingObject.description: One embedding object in the response list.

embedding.description: The embedding vector in the requested encoding.

index.description: Position of the input in the request.

oneOf.description: IEEE-754 `f32` values returned as a JSON array.

EmbeddingPayload.description: Either the float array or the base64 form of an embedding.

input.description: Input strings, either one string or a list of strings.

model.description: Model id to embed with; must appear in `GET /v1/models`.

EmbeddingUsage.description: Token accounting for an embeddings request.

ErrorEnvelope.description: Top-level error object returned by every failing HTTP handler.

FunctionDefinition.description: An OpenAI function definition carried by a [`Tool`].

name.description: Function name used by `tool_choice` and emitted in tool calls.

parameters.description: JSON-schema parameters; only flat object properties are used for generation.

name.description: Name of a function declared in the request's `tools`.

status.description: Always `ok` while the process is alive.

Model.description: One model reported by the OpenAI model-list endpoint.

id.description: Model identifier used in generation requests (the GGUF file stem).

owned_by.description: Owner of the model; `quarrel-rs` for locally discovered files.

data.description: Models discovered from the configured models directory, sorted by id.

OllamaChatMessage.description: One chat message in Ollama's shape.

model.description: Model id to generate with; must appear in `GET /v1/models`.

stream.description: Return newline-delimited JSON chunks when `true`; defaults to `false`.

OllamaChatResponse.description: Non-streaming `POST /api/chat` response and each streamed chunk.

done.description: `true` on the final chunk of a stream.

done_reason.description: Ollama finish reason, present when `done` is `true`.

eval_count.description: Number of generated tokens, present on non-streaming responses.

message.description: Generated message; the role is always `assistant`.

prompt_eval_count.description: Number of prompt tokens, present on non-streaming responses.

model.description: Model id to generate with; must appear in `GET /v1/models`.

stream.description: Return newline-delimited JSON chunks when `true`; defaults to `false`.

suffix.description: Ollama suffix field; accepted for client compatibility but not rendered by the fixture.

system.description: Optional system instruction prepended to the conversation.

done.description: `true` on the final chunk of a stream.

done_reason.description: Ollama finish reason, present when `done` is `true`.

eval_count.description: Number of generated tokens, present on non-streaming responses.

prompt_eval_count.description: Number of prompt tokens, present on non-streaming responses.

response.description: Generated text; empty on the final chunk of a stream.

OllamaOptions.description: Sampling options accepted inside an Ollama request's `options` object.

num_predict.description: Ollama's name for the maximum number of generated tokens.

repeat_penalty.description: Repetition penalty applied to already-generated tokens.

oneOf.description: Stop strings, either one string or a list.

model_loaded.description: Whether at least one GGUF model was discovered.

status.description: `ready` when the configured models directory exists.

StringOrList.description:
A JSON value that may be a single string or an array of strings.

Used by `input` on embedding requests, `prompt` on completion requests and `stop` on generation
requests. Keeping the untagged representation in the DTO means handlers never have to accept
`serde_json::Value` and lose compile-time checking.

Tool.description: An OpenAI tool description. Only `type: "function"` is supported.

function.description: Function name, description and JSON-schema parameters.

ToolCall.description: A complete tool call emitted in an assistant message.

function.description: Function name and JSON-encoded arguments string.

ToolCallDelta.description: One incremental tool-call delta in an SSE chunk.

id.description: Call id, present on the first delta of a tool call.

index.description: Zero-based tool-call index, matching OpenAI's streaming shape.

type.description: Discriminator, present on the first delta of a tool call.

arguments.description: Arguments encoded as a JSON object string.
Fragment of the JSON-encoded arguments string.

name.description: Function name, present on the first delta of a tool call.

oneOf.description: Any other string, preserved so the service can return a typed 400.

ToolChoice.description: OpenAI `tool_choice`: a mode string, a named function object, or an unsupported string.

Usage.description: Token accounting shared by chat and completion responses.

total_tokens.description: Sum of prompt and completion tokens.
